scope: Methodological comparisons only; published work does not report this fitted final model on these splits.

comparisons.title: Reciprocal rank fusion outperforms Condorcet and individual rank learning methods
comparisons.published_result: TREC Robust MAP: RRF 0.3686; best individual 0.3586 (Table 2).
comparisons.local_result: RRF MAP 0.2926 versus dense 0.3229; RRF MRR and nDCG@10 are higher locally.
comparisons.reason: Different corpora, queries, relevance judgments and ranking depths. Shared fusion formula permits a methodological comparison only; published MAP cannot be subtracted from local MAP. Fusion is not guaranteed to improve every metric.

comparisons.title: Multilingual E5 Text Embeddings: A Technical Report
comparisons.published_result: MIRACL development, average over 16 languages: mE5-small nDCG@10 60.8 and R@100 92.4, on a 0-100 scale (Table 4).
comparisons.local_result: E5-small nDCG@10 0.4274 on ten Swedish definition queries.
comparisons.reason: MIRACL passage retrieval has different languages, supervision, query formulation and candidate pools from historical Swedish definition matching. The paper supports the encoder choice, not a numerical improvement claim here.

comparisons.title: Unsupervised Cross-lingual Representation Learning at Scale
comparisons.published_result: Cross-lingual classification, question answering and named entity recognition benchmarks.
comparisons.local_result: Frozen XLM-R plus supervised logistic regression: local official F1 0.4892.
comparisons.reason: Different tasks, datasets, training and metrics. A frozen sentence representation with a local classifier is not the paper's benchmark setup; it also does not supply the missing XLM-R retrieval ablation.

comparisons.title: SemEval-2020 Task 1: Unsupervised Lexical Semantic Change Detection
comparisons.published_result: Word-level change classification uses accuracy; graded change ranking uses Spearman correlation (Section 5.1).
comparisons.local_result: Usage-level binary definition matching, averaged positive-class F1 over lemmas.
comparisons.reason: The Swedish language and diachronic setting are related, but prediction units, labels, data partitions and metrics differ. The 2020 task cannot serve as a directly comparable 2027 leaderboard.
